header.title: SSSS October Newsletter
header.description: BOO! It's finally SSSSpooky season here at SFU so let's recap some (paranormal?) activities from September, a spooktacular Fall 2026 Election, and some scaretastic events coming soon!

text: We've tallied the votes and are happy to anounce the winners of this past election!
Director of Visual Design: Andrew Hung
Director of Marketing: Sukhdeep Kaur Somal
First Year Representatives: Nusayba Khan, Aaron Lama, Darren Teo
Congratulations on a successful election campaign!
Thank you to all who applied and voted, you're engagement in the SSSS is valued <3
SOSY and CSSS students learned how to navigate their degrees with advice from SFU Faculty and Alumni/Students, alongside practicing their networking skills!
Biggest of Thank-You's to Professors Nick Sumber and Steven Ko, along with Brian Rahadi, Gahee Kim, Mekdim Dereje, Chloe Yip, and Mantaj Dhillon!
